items.title: Mike Wofford interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 13, 1998
items.q: I worked with Ray Brown on some recordings up there

ctx.x: That’s great. What’s in the close future for you? More of the same?

Well I still travel some. I stay primarily in San Diego. I do some work in L.A. I just was up there earlier this week, I worked with Ray Brown on some recordings up there, with a wonderful — the first time I’d worked with him, I’d admired him on recordings but first time I’d met him or worked with him, Ralph Moore, a wonderful tenor and soprano player. Marvelous. He is now in L.A. I didn’t realize that. I thought he was still in New York but you know so many guys have moved out here, and I had a drummer named…
